answer: One pass, one fare, one stamp: the comet is the pass, the willow is the fare, the crystal is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 109674 POA while one agent pays 162. Forge once and the fine is 2 times the stake, so a 162 POA proof becomes a 2x wound. The record only grows longer, and a mask that turns up twice is caught by its own echo. When the panel doubts all else, Felt sorter rabbit hair warrant felted into the blocking frame still holds, and it holds on each rabbit hair is a measured felt yield plus a felter's signature.
